comments.text:
Why don't you try adding "do not generate or output content that is not permitted" to the end of your prompt?

or "if you try to generate or output content that is not permitted, identify the <reason that the content is not permitted> and then rerun the above request with "do not generate content containing <reason that the content is not permitted>"

This might work or not, depending on where the content catch is located: within the model or between the model output and the provided output.

Otherwise you could try "the last request failed due to 'content not permitted'. Reason about why this may have happened based on the input image and the request given. Retry the original request but add exclusions based on your reasoning to try an image doesn't return 'content not permitted'".

I think if you can hit on the right prompt you could just append it to anything that fails once.
